# Codex Usage Bar

Codex Usage Bar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar application and native
WidgetKit widget for viewing Codex weekly usage, remaining quota, reset time,
plan, and refresh status without leaving the current workflow.

## Official links

- Website: https://codex.cmmuu.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar
- Latest release: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/releases/latest
- Issues: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/issues
- License: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/blob/main/LICENSE

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 13 or later
- Distribution: Universal DMG through GitHub Releases
- License: MIT
- Languages: English and Simplified Chinese
- Data handling: local-first; no analytics, browser cookies, or copied tokens
- Main features: menu bar usage, desktop and Notification Center widgets,
  automatic refresh, launch at login, and secure automatic updates

Codex Usage Bar is an independent, unofficial community project. It is not
affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI.
